description: This file defines the TaxonomyIndexProvider class, which implements indexing logic for taxonomy fields within content items in OrchardCore. It includes methods for describing index mappings and processing content items to generate taxonomy index entries.

classes.name: TaxonomyIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing for taxonomy fields in content items, implementing the IScopedIndexProvider interface.

methods.name: TaxonomyIndexProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service provider dependency.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Defines how content items are mapped to taxonomy index entries, including filtering out deleted or irrelevant items and extracting taxonomy field data.
